text:
Aapki pareshani ke liye main maafi chahta hoon. Photo khichna aur pehle hi suraksha rakhna accha kiya aapne. 

Maine aapke order **ORD-22006** ke liye ₹2199 ka **refund initiate** kar diya hai. Yeh amount aapke original payment method par 3-5 working days mein credit ho jayega. 

Kya main aapki kisi aur baat mein madad kar sakta hoon?
